SELECT cr.id, cr.patient_id AS patient_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dept.name AS department_name, cr.ended_at AS completed_at, cr.updated_at FROM consult_record cr JOIN doctor d ON d.id = cr.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = d.dept_id WHERE cr.patient_id = #{patientId} AND cr.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cr.doctor_note IS NOT NULL AND btrim(cr.doctor_note) != '' AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cr.ended_at DESC NULLS LAST, cr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
